children: to buy 38% stake Our Bureau New Delhi: Warburg Pincus will acquire a 38% stake in a unit of Coimbatore-based auto components player Pricol for 1,663 crore, as per a stock exchange disclosure late evening on Friday. Topaz Terrace Investments, an affiliate of Warburg Pincus, will purchase the stake in the Pricol unit that manufactures digital dashboards and instrument clusters for two-wheeler companies such as TVS Motor, Honda Motorcycle & Scooter, Royal Enfield and Ather Energy.

The driver information and connected vehicle solution business will be demerged into a company called Pricol Autotech, as per the disclosure. ET first reported on Thursday that Warburg Pincus was leading the race to acquire a minority stake in a unit of Pricol. The deal will entail a stake purchase from existing shareholders of the Pricol unit, including Vijay Mohan, Vikram Mohan, Vanitha Mohan, Viren Mohan, Manasa Mohan, Madhura Mohan and certain other promoter entities.

Following the proposed demerger, the actuation, control and fluid management systems business will continue to operate under Pricol, while the polymer business will continue to operate through Pricol's wholly-owned subsidiary, Pricol Precision Products. Both businesses will remain under the ownership and management of the current promoter group, the Mohan family, with no change in their shareholding.

title: Warburg to Buy Stake in Pricol Unit for 1,663 cr
